answer: Meadow table bond blocks mass fakes: each identity tends one meadow plot, locks a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it files the plot's growth delta with a fresh echo-return time binding the plot key. Auditors recompute each delta from the public table; an out-of-band delta, reused echo, or rented echo burns the bond. First 38, k-th 38+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep the bond.
